QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your beginnings to regain your lost memory. Beginnings? Does he mean when you first decided to follow the Black Mage... Or when you first turned against the Black Mage? Or even when you awoke in the Resistance base?
QuestInfo.1: Mother... Damien... You remember your family. This was what you were searching for.
